newsitem.title: USA: Metzler Group acquires consulting firm.
newsitem.headline: Metzler Group acquires consulting firm.

text.p: Metzler Group Inc said Wednesday it acquired Burgess Consultants Inc, a Northbrook, Illinois-based consulting firm.
Financial terms for the transaction, which will be accounted for as a pooling fo interests, were not disclosed.
Burgess provides management consulting to the electric, gas, telecommunications and water/wastewater industries, as well as state public service commissions.
The deal is Metzler Group's first acquisition as a public company.

"Currently, we have several other companies we're reviewing, and we expect to continue to execute our strategy of growth through acquisition," Robert Maher, chief executive officer of Metzler Group, a consulting firm that went public in October, said.
Metzler Group shares fell 1/4 to 22 Wednesday.
